snippet.title: Duet Night Abyss | Huaxu Version – The Wind Awakening · Part II Trailer
snippet.description:
The Huaxu Version – The Wind Awakening · Part II will officially launch on February 10.

✦ New Characters & Weapons Available
New characters Zhiliu and Yuming will become available, with new weapons and Demon Wedges released simultaneously!

✦ New Skins & Accessories Added
Winter reveries, renewed styles!
The Frosty Fantasy snowbound adventure style, the Fleeting Traces academy journey style, along with a series of exquisite accessories, are making their debut!

✦ New Limited Myriad Outfit
Moonlit shadows dance as gilded splendor graces the night—
Epulary Elegance, Zhiliu's brand-new qipao outfit, arrives in dazzling style!

✦ New Mounts Added
Ride without limits—charge boldly ahead!
The Blade-run Knight heavy motorcycle, the adorable Filbert, let's go go go! mount, and the Mecha-Taihao argent loong mount are all arriving on the wind!

✦ Download Duet Night Abyss
https://bit.ly/4qpfs9n 

#DuetNightAbyss #Huaxu #Zhiliu #Yuming
